Hello remixers!

I suspect at least a few of you will just want to change the builtin song selection and maybe even just make a single song play on loop. If that's you, keep reading this.

Use the converter (https://garbomuffin.github.io/nbs) to generate a code for your song, then click on the block to the right to show an internal list. Each item of this list is parsed and displayed in the menu when the project is started, so just replace the default ones with the songs you want.

You should notice that the beginning part of the song data is an @ sign followed by the name of the song, which makes it easy enough to figure out which one is which. Items that don't start with an @ will be treated as section dividers.

If you make the list contain exactly one item, then that song will be played automatically without the user choosing what to play (make sure you don't have any section dividers or empty rows)

This sprite is also the thumbnail sprite.
